value.rationale: The mathematical object is the natural worst Hausdorff cap in boundary-random convex-hull approximation. The explicit Gaussian localization and mixture weights identify where rare failures occur and jointly track their severity, resolving structural dependence not contained in scalar approximation or classical spacing CDFs. They do not require an unrelated downstream theorem for value.
